name: Pork Chop & Pinto Bean Salad (Cowboy Caviar) with Cilantro Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 ½ green bell peppers
3 tomatoes
1 ½ avocados

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse beans; set aside to drain further.
Juice limes into a large bowl. Add oil, honey, and spices; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the pork chops dry with paper towels and place on a plate. Season with spices on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 pork chops, boneless
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and mince onion; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Mince and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers; add to the bowl.
Small dice tomatoes and add to the bowl.
Halve and pit avocados; scoop out with a spoon and small dice the flesh. Add to the bowl, along with the beans, and stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide chops and bean salad between plates. Enjoy!
